conf.description: Building Automation (Niagara) alarm-events syslog-raw direct route: hand-built RFC3164 envelope + alarm-record parse, severity inversion and lifecycle uuid correlation, no vendor pack/integration exists

conf.comment: Niagara AlarmService records rendered into syslog (same station-log stream as, or a console/relay recipient alongside, the audit feed). No Niagara Elastic integration or Cribl pack exists; hand-built regex parser keyed on the documented alarm record properties. Re-test on every Niagara point release.

functions.description: Split the RFC3164 envelope (HOSTNAME) from the Niagara-rendered alarm content (MSG); PRI/TAG not used by this dataset's field map

Extract the documented alarm record properties from the rendered record (assumed semicolon-delimited label:value grammar - no confirmed sample; ORDs contain literal pipes so pipe-delimiting was avoided)

Custom bas.niagara.alarm.* namespace copies plus the priority-to-severity inversion (Niagara 1=most urgent/255=least, inverse of ECS numeric severity); event.outcome intentionally NOT set here - the vendor record has no success/failure notion and recommendations.direct.cribl assigns that derivation to the Elastic ingest pipeline
Batch rename of the directly-mapped columns; event.id (uuid) is the only cross-record correlation key across the offnormal/acknowledge/return-to-normal lifecycle
Event time from the alarm record's own Timestamp property (platform constraint: never target @timestamp)
Set event.dataset (no hyphen) and drop staging fields consumed into their ECS/custom targets above
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
